name: Logitech C920s Pro HD Webcam
description: A Full HD 1080p webcam with autofocus, automatic light correction, dual stereo microphones and a privacy shutter. A practical option for online classes and video meetings.

name: Dell Pro 3 Webcam 2K (WB3023)
description: A 2K QHD webcam supporting up to 2560 × 1440 resolution at 60 fps, with a 78° field of view, autofocus and built-in microphone. Check device and software compatibility before buying.

name: Logitech MX Keys S Wireless Keyboard
description: A low-profile wireless keyboard with smart backlighting, programmable keys and multi-device switching. Designed for comfortable, precise typing at a desk.

name: Anker USB-C Hub (7-in-1)
description: A compact USB-C hub that adds multiple connections, including HDMI, USB and card access. The manufacturer lists 4K at 60Hz HDMI output and up to 85W charging; verify your laptop's USB-C capabilities.

name: Samsung T7 Shield Portable SSD (1TB)
description: A rugged 1TB portable SSD with USB 3.2 Gen 2, IP65-rated protection and advertised sequential read/write speeds of up to 1,050/1,000 MB/s. Actual speeds depend on the connected device and setup.

name: JBL Flip 6 Portable Bluetooth Speaker
description: A compact Bluetooth speaker with IP67 water and dust resistance and up to 12 hours of advertised playtime. A practical pick for travel and everyday listening.

name: TP-Link Tapo C210 Pan/Tilt Home Security Camera
description: An indoor pan-and-tilt Wi-Fi camera with 2K resolution, motion detection and two-way audio. Check local privacy rules and storage options before purchase.

name: Ninja Air Fryer (AF101)
description: A compact air fryer designed for air frying, roasting, reheating and dehydrating. Check basket capacity and counter space to make sure it suits your household.

name: Instant Pot Duo 7-in-1 Electric Pressure Cooker
description: A multi-cooker that combines pressure cooking, slow cooking, steaming, sautéing, rice cooking, yogurt making and warming. Choose the capacity that fits your family size.

name: Oral-B iO Series 5 Electric Toothbrush
description: An electric toothbrush with a pressure sensor and app-connected brushing guidance. Brush-head replacements and regional availability should be checked before buying.

name: Philips OneBlade Hybrid Trimmer
description: A rechargeable grooming tool designed to trim, edge and shave facial hair. Check the exact model and included attachments, as kits vary by market.

name: Herschel Classic Backpack
description: A simple everyday backpack for commuting, study and travel. Compare the selected size, laptop sleeve details and fabric before ordering.

name: Casio G-Shock DW-5600 Digital Watch
description: A durable digital watch with shock resistance, stopwatch, countdown timer and water resistance. Confirm the exact DW-5600 variant and dimensions before purchase.

name: Google Fitbit Charge 6 Fitness Tracker
description: A fitness tracker with activity and heart-rate tracking, built-in GPS and up to 7 days of advertised battery life. Feature availability and some insights may depend on app, phone and subscription.

name: Manduka PRO Yoga Mat
description: A dense, durable yoga mat designed for regular practice and studio use. It is a premium, heavier mat, so check dimensions and weight before ordering.

name: Owala FreeSip Insulated Water Bottle
description: An insulated stainless-steel bottle with a dual-purpose FreeSip spout for sipping or using the built-in straw. Check size, lid care and colour availability.

name: Hydro Flask 32 oz Wide Mouth Bottle
description: A reusable insulated bottle for everyday hydration, commuting and outdoor use. Check lid compatibility and bottle dimensions before purchase.

name: Sony WH-CH720N Wireless Noise Canceling Headphones
description: Lightweight wireless over-ear headphones with noise cancelling, ambient sound modes and multipoint Bluetooth connectivity. Check regional availability and included accessories.

name: Anker 737 Power Bank (PowerCore 24K)
description: A high-capacity portable charger with USB-C Power Delivery and a display for charging information. Confirm laptop and device compatibility, airline limits and regional model specifications.

name: Logitech MX Master 3S Wireless Mouse
description: An ergonomic productivity mouse with quiet clicks, a high-precision sensor and customizable controls. Check hand size, operating-system support and receiver compatibility.

name: OXO Good Grips Salad Spinner
description: A countertop salad spinner with a pump mechanism and a non-slip base, designed to wash and dry leafy greens. Check dimensions and storage space.

name: KitchenAid 5-Speed Hand Blender
description: A versatile immersion blender with multiple speed settings for blending soups, smoothies and sauces. Review included attachments and jar capacity for the exact model.

name: Cuisinart Custom 14-Cup Food Processor
description: A full-size food processor for chopping, slicing, shredding and mixing larger batches. Consider its countertop footprint and included discs before choosing.

name: Revlon One-Step Volumizer PLUS
description: A hot-air styling brush with an oval head, multiple heat settings and a detachable design for blowout-style results. Use heat protection and follow the manufacturer's hair-type guidance.

name: FOREO LUNA 4 Facial Cleansing Device
description: A rechargeable silicone facial cleansing device with app-connected routines. Review the model-specific features, skin-care guidance and replacement or warranty terms.

name: Panasonic nanoe Hair Dryer
description: A hair dryer from Panasonic's nanoe range, designed for everyday drying and styling. Confirm the exact model, voltage and plug type for your country before ordering.

name: Levi's 501 Original Fit Jeans
description: The classic straight-fit denim style with a button fly. Check the size guide, inseam and wash options because fit and fabric can vary by version.

name: Adidas Classic 3-Stripes Backpack
description: A practical everyday backpack with a simple sports-inspired design for commuting, study and casual use. Check capacity, laptop protection and dimensions on the selected variant.

name: New Balance 574 Core Sneakers
description: A versatile lifestyle sneaker with the familiar 574 silhouette for everyday casual wear. Use the brand's size guide and check width options before ordering.

name: BowFlex SelectTech 552 Adjustable Dumbbells
description: Adjustable dumbbells with multiple weight settings that can replace several pairs of fixed dumbbells. Check available model generation, weight range and shipping restrictions.

name: Theragun Mini Percussive Massage Device
description: A compact percussive massage device designed for portable muscle recovery routines. Follow the manufacturer's safety guidance and avoid use on injured areas without professional advice.

name: TRX All-in-One Suspension Training System
description: A suspension training kit for bodyweight exercises at home or while travelling. Check the anchor requirements and installation instructions for your intended setup.

name: Stanley Quencher H2.0 FlowState Tumbler (40 oz)
description: A reusable insulated stainless-steel tumbler with a handle, reusable straw and three-position lid. Check dimensions and lid care; it is designed to fit many, but not all, vehicle cup holders.

name: Tile Mate Bluetooth Item Tracker
description: A small Bluetooth tracker designed to help locate everyday items such as keys and bags using the companion app. Check phone compatibility, network limitations and subscription features.

name: simplehuman Rechargeable Sensor Pump
description: A touch-free soap dispenser designed for kitchen or bathroom counters. Confirm the selected size, soap compatibility and charging method before purchase.
